q: After a password database leak, the first priority is …
o: forcing resets / revoking sessions and notifying affected users

q: A stolen session cookie is best limited by …
o: short idle timeouts, rotation and server-side revocation
why: Server-side sessions can be killed instantly.

q: If you can't detect a failure, you can't respond to it.
why: Fact: plan how you'd notice each failure (alerts on login spikes, resets, new devices).
